title: EUV 多層膜反射鏡
summary: 從 EUV 強吸收出發，理解 Mo/Si 多層膜為何能反射、週期與粗糙度如何決定反射率，再把面形、鍍膜應力、污染、熱負載與波前誤差預算整合成可驗收的反射鏡工程。
summaryEn: Start from strong EUV absorption to see why Mo/Si multilayers reflect, how period and roughness set reflectance, then integrate figure, coating stress, contamination, thermal load and wavefront budgets into an acceptable mirror engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」與「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" and "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「反射式光路與真空腔」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「反射式光路與真空腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「反射式光路與真空腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構
knowledge.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture
knowledge.text: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。
knowledge.textEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「EUV 多層膜反射鏡」的「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: mechanism and system boundary” in “EUV multilayer mirrors”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Optical Bench: Missing Focus” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" is correct?
options: 只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。
在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小。
雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
optionsEn: With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV.
At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption.
More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 在 13.5 nm 波長，所有固體材料的折射率都非常接近 1 且吸收係數很大，折射率可寫成 n = 1 − δ + iβ，δ 與 β 都只有百分之幾或更小；光在數十奈米內就被吸收，所以不能用透鏡折射成像，整個光路必須放在真空中並以多層膜反射鏡轉折與聚焦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At 13.5 nm every solid has a refractive index very close to 1 with strong absorption; writing n = 1 − δ + iβ, both δ and β are a few percent or less, and the light is absorbed within tens of nanometers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反射式光路與真空腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。
knowledge.textEn: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture", which statement holds?
options: 基板很厚時，幾百奈米薄膜的應力可以忽略。
λ/4 的面形品質對任何波長都是「繞射極限」。
單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²。
optionsEn: For a thick substrate the stress of a few hundred nanometres of film is negligible.
λ/4 figure quality is diffraction limited at any wavelength.
A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence.
quiz.explanation: 單一界面的正向反射率約為 R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|²；當 δ 只有 0.01 量級時，單一界面反射率僅約 10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ 等級，只有把數十個界面以相同相位疊加才能得到可用的反射率。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: A single interface reflects roughly R ≈ |(n₁ − n₂)/(n₁ + n₂)|² at normal incidence; with δ of order 0.01 that is only 10⁻⁴ to 10⁻³, so a usable reflectance needs tens of interfaces adding in phase. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「反射式光路與真空腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。
knowledge.textEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture"?
options: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
optionsEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.
quiz.explanation: 以公開的光學常數資料庫（例如 CXRO）查 Mo 與 Si 在 13.5 nm 的 δ、β，計算單界面反射率與 1/e 吸收深度，並與多層膜的實測反射率曲線比較，確認差了兩到三個數量級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Look up δ and β of Mo and Si at 13.5 nm from a public optical-constants database such as CXRO, compute the single-interface reflectance and the 1/e absorption depth, and compare with a measured multilayer reflectance curve to confirm the two-to-three-order-of-magnitude gap. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: EUV 強吸收與反射式架構：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反射式光路與真空腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Reflective optical path and vacuum chamber” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空氣本身也會吸收 EUV，因此照明、光罩與投影光學都在真空腔內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Refractive lenses therefore cannot image EUV, so the whole optical train is folded and focused by multilayer mirrors inside a vacuum chamber, because air itself absorbs EUV as well.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要材料夠純、夠透明，EUV 也能像 DUV 一樣用透鏡成像。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With pure enough transparent material, EUV could be imaged with lenses like DUV." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
knowledge.textEn: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「EUV 強吸收與反射式架構」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strong EUV absorption and the reflective architecture" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。
雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist.
More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 若把 DUV 的折射式鏡頭觀念套到 EUV，會估出根本不存在的透鏡光路；真實失效是光在元件內被吸收而沒有能量到達晶圓，系統通量不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Carrying DUV refractive-lens thinking into EUV produces a lens train that cannot exist; the real failure is light absorbed inside the element so that throughput at the wafer collapses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」如何決定EUV 多層膜反射鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mo/Si multilayer stack” determines the key performance of “EUV multilayer mirrors”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。各界面的微弱反射在正向入射時因為光程差等於一個波長而同相疊加，形成類似布拉格繞射的反射峰；由於材料吸收，週期數超過約 50 組後反射率不再提升。理論峰值約 74%，實際鍍膜約 70%。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless. The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mo/Si multilayer stack”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More bilayers always give higher reflectance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mo/Si multilayer stack”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。各界面的微弱反射在正向入射時因為光程差等於一個波長而同相疊加，形成類似布拉格繞射的反射峰；由於材料吸收，週期數超過約 50 組後反射率不再提升。
knowledge.textEn: A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The weak reflections from each interface add in phase at normal incidence because the round-trip path equals one wavelength, giving a Bragg-like reflectance peak; absorption makes additional bilayers beyond about 50 useless.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More bilayers always give higher reflectance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition" is correct?
options: 雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。
達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。
Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。
optionsEn: More bilayers always give higher reflectance.
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4.
quiz.explanation: Mo/Si 多層膜由約 40 到 50 組雙層構成，每組週期 d 約 6.9 nm，Mo 約佔週期的 0.4。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A Mo/Si multilayer has about 40 to 50 bilayers with a period d of roughly 6.9 nm and a molybdenum fraction near 0.4. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mo/Si multilayer stack” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。週期誤差會按 Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d 推移峰值波長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. A period error shifts the peak by Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。週期誤差會按 Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d 推移峰值波長。
knowledge.textEn: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. A period error shifts the peak by Δλ/λ ≈ Δd/d.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition", which statement holds?
options: 修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ。
在真空中工作的鏡面不會受到污染。
超低膨脹材料就表示熱變形為零。
optionsEn: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ.
A mirror working in vacuum cannot get contaminated.
Ultralow-expansion material means zero thermal deformation.
quiz.explanation: 修正折射後的布拉格條件為 mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ)，其中 δ̄ 是週期平均的 δ；在正向入射（θ = 90°）、m = 1、λ = 13.5 nm、δ̄ ≈ 0.02 時，d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The refraction-corrected Bragg condition is mλ = 2d·sinθ·√(1 − 2δ̄/sin²θ) with δ̄ the period-averaged δ; at normal incidence, m = 1, λ = 13.5 nm and δ̄ ≈ 0.02, d ≈ λ/(2√(1 − 2δ̄)) ≈ 6.89 nm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Mo/Si multilayer stack” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。
knowledge.textEn: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Multilayer period and the Bragg condition"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較。
每片鏡子都通過驗收，整組光學就自動合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II.
If every mirror passes, the assembled optics automatically pass.
quiz.explanation: 用布拉格式算出目標週期後，與同步輻射反射率計（例如 PTB 在 BESSY II 的 EUV 反射率量測）給出的峰值波長與頻寬比較；再改變週期 ±1% 預測峰值位移約 ±0.14 nm，與量測比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: After computing the target period from the Bragg relation, compare with the peak wavelength and bandwidth from synchrotron reflectometry such as the PTB EUV reflectometry at BESSY II; then perturb the period by ±1%, predict a peak shift of about ±0.14 nm and check against measurement. steps.title: 多層膜週期與布拉格條件：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multilayer period and the Bragg condition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Mo/Si 多層膜堆」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Mo/Si multilayer stack” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：理論峰值約 74%，實際鍍膜約 70%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The theoretical peak is about 74% and production coatings reach about 70%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「雙層數越多，反射率一定越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More bilayers always give higher reflectance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。
knowledge.textEn: Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance; if the lateral period gradient does not match the designed angle-of-incidence map, different mirror zones peak at different wavelengths and both reflectance and uniformity degrade.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多層膜週期與布拉格條件」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

達到可見光光學的光滑度，對 EUV 也足夠。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A surface smooth enough for visible optics is smooth enough for EUV.
Interdiffusion that forms MoSi₂ broadens the effective interface and lowers reflectance.
quiz.explanation: 界面互擴散形成 MoSi₂ 會讓有效界面變寬、反射率下降；週期沿鏡面漸變若與設計的入射角分佈不符，鏡面不同位置的峰值波長會錯開，整鏡反射率與均勻性同時變差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
